relevant_laws.notes: Highway, district and frontage/building use require original local source review.
relevant_laws.quote: A signal of intention to turn left or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: source-gated highway left turn with district-specific distance
